protocol: V66 precommit before any Fuzzers reserve scoring

diagnostic_used_for_engineering.interpretation: V65 exposed severe seed instability. Worms is development diagnostic from V66 onward and is not a V66 reserve claim.

fresh_reserve.selection_basis: latest still-unscored support-qualified family in the V64 support-only candidate list after excluding Analysis (already development-scored), Worms (V65 inspected), Backdoor aliases (contaminated/development), and choosing the later eligible campaign ahead of Shellcode

stability_change.nonlinear_transfer: average probabilities from a fixed three-member ExtraTrees ensemble rather than tying ExtraTrees random_state to the outer world-model seed
stability_change.reason: reduce algorithmic seed variance without looking at Fuzzers outcomes

selection_contract.selection_data: development campaigns only; Fuzzers blocked from fit/calibration/policy/fusion selection

reporting_contract.conservative_view: minimum per-seed Wilson lower 95% recall bound and maximum per-seed Wilson upper 95% FPR bound
